verdict.rationale: Notte's marketing site lists "Live View & Replays: Screenshare & session playback" as a product capability, so recorded session replays exist in some form. The docs also mention a live ViewerUrl and describe the platform as a place to "build, debug, and deploy" workflows. However, the replay claim is a single marketing line with no documentation of how replays are accessed or what they contain. missing for 10: documented video replay retrieval, per-step screenshots, step-by-step action timelines/logs for agent runs, docs on debugging a failed run from replays, independent or hands-on corroboration.
